missing_scope.replacement_observation: The same source parent now exposes 29 new 2.01 kg variant IDs 4215-4243 with different flavours and no GTIN; this is not sufficient identity evidence for rebinding.

whey_okay.root_cause: The classifier correctly isolated missing rows, but aggregate two-capture confirmation fingerprinted all approved records and threw INTERNAL_ERROR when a review-only row was absent.

correction.scope: Whey Okay edge coordinator interaction only
correction.behavior: Fingerprint matched mapped rows and independently bind the exact missing-source-key set across both captures.

fit_house.root_cause: One identity in the seven-row protected absence scope returned to the source; the full-source fingerprint stopped before the narrower returned-identity guard could report it.

watchdog_correlation.root_cause: The watchdog selects only successful stage steps, can stitch ordinary stages from different older runs, and has no latest-failed-attempt artifact contract.
watchdog_correlation.impact: Direct zero-write artifacts remain valid, but the current watchdog cannot serve as the final RA-STAB closeout proof.
watchdog_correlation.required_follow_up: Separate latest_attempt from last_complete_success and forbid ordinary cross-run stage stitching before final closeout.

decision.whey_next_step: Merge the bounded interaction correction and observe the next ordinary schedule without automatically rebinding the ten missing variants.
decision.fit_house_next_step: Obtain one exact owner decision for returned offer 759; keep the other six protected offers unchanged.
decision.watchdog_next_step: Implement the shared read-only latest-attempt correlation correction after the fingerprint class is closed.
